name: NHS inform — diagnosing autistic young people and adults
description: NHS inform guidance for young people and adults in Scotland about recognising possible autism and seeking formal assessment through local healthcare routes.
intended_use: Use as the national Scotland-facing starting route for a young person or adult considering autism assessment.
audience_or_context: Young people and adults in Scotland, and people supporting them.
limitations: Operational referral arrangements and waiting times can vary by NHS board and local service.
The page is information about diagnosis and cannot establish whether a particular person is autistic.
cost_or_access_notes: Publicly accessible online; NHS access depends on local pathways.
conflicts_of_interest: NHS inform is Scotland's national health information service; ND Oracle records the official route without assuming a local service outcome.

provenance.method: Current NHS inform autism diagnosis page checked on 2026-09-03 for Scotland-facing assessment access and process context. Listing is descriptive and claimless.
